releases.notes:
## 🍵 Important
[Matcha Flavoured](https://modrinth.com/datapack/matcha-flavoured) has inspired me to reconsider making the enchantments craftable.
I am thinking of making the progression system to unlock this ability, or rework the enchanting table to allow crafting though it.
If you like to join the discussion join the [BTA-Better With Enchanting channel](https://discord.com/channels/866992171319558144/1167885648879951993).

## 📚 Changes:
- Enchanting Table's model can now be adjusted with assets packs
- Additional arrow shot from an enchanted bow are now fire the main arrow arrow type.
- The calculations for the chance for unbreaking to trigger has been changed. This has no effect for unbreaking with level 1 or 2.

## 🐛 BugFixes:
- Enchanting Table's book was adjusted to rotate pages more slowly and less frequently
- Hud component score can now be hidden properly
- Achievement score can now no longer gained from consuming un-enchanted food.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Redart15/BetterWithEnchanting/compare/1.1.9+8.0.1...1.1.10+8.0.1

## 📚 Changes:
- Command `/enchant info [name] verbose` now requires in survival to have the achievement "Time to Study!" to be unlocked.
- Adjusted "Unbreaking":
  - Level 1 extends the tools durability by 50% up from 33%.

## 🐛 BugFixes:
- "Unbreaking" now correct applies to tool.
- Armor can no longer be enchanted with "Unbreaking".

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Redart15/BetterWithEnchanting/compare/1.1.8+8.0.1...1.1.9+8.0.1

## 📚 Changes
- "Flame" can no longer be applied to bows. Existing flame enchantment continue to work.

## 🐛  BugFixes:
- Health preview now account for the increased healing provided by "Filling".
- Achievement "Time to Study!" no longer resets when rejoining the server.
- Unbreaking now correct applies to enchanted items It would previously only applied to armor and armor was not enchantable.
- Score is now handled correct and enchanting does not increase it anymore.
- improved the command response for `\score removed` 

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Redart15/BetterWithEnchanting/compare/1.1.7+8.0.1...1.1.8+8.0.1

## 📚 Changes:
- Time to Study! can now be acquired by opening the interface when crafting of the enchanter is disabled.
- Study Up! uses now the enchanted book as icon.
- Enchanter now uses cobble stone instead of obsidian as a base.

## 🐛 BugFixes:
- Achievements no longer load client side classes on server.
- Tools are no longer by default hasted.
- Level 2 in Haste can be acquired again, was previously prevented by a bug.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Redart15/BetterWithEnchanting/compare/1.1.6+8.0.1...1.1.7+8.0.1

## Update The mod is now updated to 8.0.1. It comes with alot of new enchantments to boot. Seek the library for long lost, and forgotten tomes of the great release wizard. ## 📚 New Enchantments: - Insight now replace Score. - Crit spawn now particles. - Food can now be enchanted. - New Enchantments: - Nourishment: Decreases the time interval in between food regeneration. - Lasting: Increase the chance of not consuming the food. - Filling: Increases the amount that food heals. - Silktouch: Mined block are dropped as if mined by a Gold Pickaxe. - Felling: Mined block are dropped as if mined by a Gold Pickaxe. - Foraging: Increases the chance to get sticks, leaves and saplings from leaves. - Explosive: Explosion causes by cannonball set the ground on fire. - Volatile: Causes explosion to damage the environment. - Precise: Allow cannonball to hit entities. - Incendiary: Explosion causes by cannonball set the ground on fire. ## 🗺️ Achievements - Time to study!: Craft an enchantment table. - It's some kind of magic: Enchant an item. - Ultimate Power: Enchant an item with all enchantments applicable to it. - Insight: Upgrade an enchantment to its highest level. - A taste of magic.: Enchant some food. - Goal!: Consume an bottle of score. - Study up!: Enchant an item using an enchantment book. diary: Explosion causes by cannonball set the ground on fire. ## 🪑 Enchanting Table - HudComponent for score. - Enchanting Table can now naturaly spawn in the Labyrinth library. - Enchanting Table can now be picked up. - Enchanting Table Item renders a functional book. - Additional config option: - DESTRUCTIBLE: Enchanting Table cannot be crafted or mined. - CHANCE: Chance for an enchanting table to spawn in the library. - CAN_PICKUP: Allows the enchanting table to be picked up. ## 💻 Commands - `/enchant info [name] verbose` for a more verbose and detailed explonation. ## 🧾 Enchanting Book Allows player to pick between two option of enchantments to apply to an item, enchanted or not. The Enchanting Books pulled out of Enchanting Bookshelfs and those can be found in Labyrinth libraries. The enchanting does not cost anything but can only be used once. ## 🪲 BugFixes: - None ## Dependecies - BTA Babric >= 8.0.1 https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-fabric-instance-repo/releases - HalpLibe >= 6.1.4 https://github.com/Turnip-Labs/bta-halplibe/releases **Full Changelog**: https://github.com/Redart15/BetterWithEnchanting/compare/1.1.4...1.1.6+8.0.1
